_meta.description: EverQuest class alias map for sos-epgp-bot /priority command. Maps every known title/alias a player might show as in the Overview tab (Class column) back to their canonical base class name and armor type.
_meta.purpose: Lookup dict loaded once at startup. Key = any title string that could appear in the sheet. Value = { base_class, armor_type }. Built to handle players whose level, epic, or AA title appears instead of the raw class name.
_meta.project_quarm_note: Project Quarm goes through Planes of Power. Berserker (added in Gates of Discord) does NOT exist on Quarm. Beastlord IS available (added in Luclin). 14 total classes.

title_categories.level_title: Earned by reaching specific character levels. Appear in /who automatically once the threshold is met. Relevant thresholds for Quarm (cap 60): lvl 51, 55, 60. Levels 65/70/75 included for completeness but will not appear on Quarm.
title_categories.epic_title: Earned by completing the class epic weapon quest (1.0, 1.5, 2.0). Player must actively choose to display this title via Shift+T. Epic 1.5 and 2.0 are post-PoP and will not appear on Quarm.
title_categories.aa_title: Earned by spending AA (Alternate Advancement) points. Unlocked in tiers by spending points across General, Archetype, and Class AA trees.
title_categories.tradeskill_title: Earned by reaching skill thresholds in tradeskills (e.g. Master Chef, Grandmaster Smith). These are NOT class-specific — any class can earn them — so they are EXCLUDED from this alias map since they cannot be used to identify a player's class.

sources.level_titles_tertiary: https://alt.games.everquest.narkive.com/K9sfswmK/different-titles-at-certain-levels (community post, original source cited as geocities/skatoolaki)
sources.armor_types: https://everquest.fandom.com/wiki/Archetype ('Plate wearers: bards, clerics, paladins, shadow knights, and warriors. Chain wearers: berserkers, rangers, rogues, and shamans. Leather wearers: beastlords, druids, and monks. Cloth wearers: enchanters, magicians, necromancers and wizards.')

discrepancies_and_uncertainties.aa_point_thresholds: ZAM wiki states AA titles unlock at 6/12/24 points (measuring 'points in General', 'points in Archtype', 'points in Class' separately). OnlineGameCommands states 6/18/42 total points. These are likely measuring different things (per-tree vs total). Recorded both; the exact unlock is not critical for the alias lookup, only the title strings matter.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.wizard_level65_title: ZAM wiki and OnlineGameCommands both spell this 'Archanist'. No level-65 Wizard has appeared in the actual EPGP sheet (Quarm is capped at 60), so the in-game string is unconfirmed. BOTH 'Archanist' and 'Arcanist' are included as defensive aliases.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.shadow_knight_spacing: CONFIRMED via SELECT DISTINCT class FROM ep_log: the sheet uses 'Shadow Knight' (two words). 'ShadowKnight' retained as defensive alias.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.warrior_epic_collision: Warrior's Epic 1.0 title is 'Champion', which is the same as their level-51 title. This is a known EQ quirk — both are mapped identically here, which is correct behavior.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.cleric_epic_collision: Cleric's Epic 2.0 title 'High Priest / Priestess' overlaps with their level-60 title 'High Priest'. Both map to Cleric, so no functional issue.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.gm_event_titles: One-off GM event titles (e.g. 'Chosen Guardian' from Tower of Frozen Shadow) are not documented and not included. If one appears in the sheet it will produce a lookup miss.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.base_class_names: Levels 1-50 characters show their base class name in /who (e.g. 'Bard', 'Wizard'). These are also included as aliases mapping to themselves.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.mage_alias: CONFIRMED via SQL: 'Mage' appears exactly once in the EP log (Galeida, 2024-10-26) — a single data entry error. Galeida's current class is Magician. 'Mage' is mapped to Magician as a defensive catch.
discrepancies_and_uncertainties.sorceror_typo: CONFIRMED via SQL: 'Sorceror' (extra 'o') appears in the EP log alongside the correct 'Sorcerer'. Both are mapped to Wizard.
